anchor.title: Anchored against humans, not software
anchor.text: A front-desk hire costs about $2,600/month. Human answering services charge $219–$309/month for a few hundred minutes. LacaStay answers every call, books every appointment, and follows up on every no-show — for less than the cost of a single missed booking.

guarantee.title: No contracts. Cancel anytime.
guarantee.text: Month-to-month billing on every plan. If LacaStay isn't paying for itself, cancel in two clicks — your data stays exportable for 30 days, no retention calls, no cancellation fees.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is there a contract or setup fee?
faq.a1: No. Every plan is month-to-month with no setup fee and no cancellation fee. Cancel anytime from your dashboard; your plan runs to the end of the billing period.
faq.a2: Starter includes up to 300 AI-answered calls per month; Growth includes up to 750. If you consistently need more, we'll move you to a higher allowance — never a surprise bill.
faq.q3: Will callers know they're talking to an AI?
faq.a3: Yes. LacaStay introduces itself on every call — 'Hi, I'm the LacaStay assistant for [your business]' — as required by state AI-disclosure laws. Callers consistently describe the experience as natural and helpful.
faq.q4: Does it work with my booking software?
faq.a4: LacaStay syncs with major salon, spa, and property-management calendars, and works with Google Calendar out of the box. If you take bookings by phone today, we can take them for you tomorrow.
faq.q5: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.a5: You can export your contacts, call logs, and booking history in CSV format at any time, including for 30 days after cancellation. After that window, your data is deleted per our retention schedule.

hero.title: Compliance you can verify
hero.sub: An AI receptionist touches regulated territory — phone calls, text messages, recordings, and customer data. Here's exactly how LacaStay handles each one.

compliance.b1d: AI voice calls follow FCC consent, hours, and opt-out rules.
compliance.b2d: Business texting registered with The Campaign Registry.
compliance.b3d: Every call opens with a clear AI disclosure.
compliance.b4d: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, audited access.
compliance.b5d: Recording announced where two-party consent applies.

tcpa.title: TCPA: AI voice, done by the book
tcpa.intro: The FCC's February 2024 ruling treats AI-generated voices as regulated calls under the Telephone Consumer Protection Act. LacaStay is built around that reality:
tcpa.l1: Prior express consent is required before AI voice calls — marketing calls require prior express written consent.
tcpa.l2: Calling hours respected: 8 a.m.–9 p.m. in the recipient's local time zone.
tcpa.l3: Instant opt-out: STOP and similar keywords are honored immediately.
tcpa.l4: National DNC Registry scrubbing plus an internal do-not-call list.
tcpa.l5: Our Terms push TCPA duties onto each business customer — you may only call or text recipients who consented, and abusive accounts are suspended.

dlc.title: 10DLC: registered business texting
dlc.text: All application-to-person SMS runs through registered 10DLC campaigns with The Campaign Registry. That means verified business identity, declared message types, and published opt-in/opt-out language — so your reminders actually get delivered instead of filtered as spam.

ai.title: AI disclosure: it always introduces itself
ai.text: California's B.O.T. Act and Utah's AI Policy Act require AI agents to disclose their artificial identity in consumer interactions. LacaStay opens every call with a clear introduction — 'Hi, I'm the LacaStay AI assistant for [business name]' — and answers truthfully if a caller asks whether it's human.

security.title: Data security
security.l1: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).
security.l2: Role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication, and full audit logging for staff access.
security.l4: Customer data is never used to train models serving other customers.

recording.title: Call-recording consent
recording.text: Calls may be recorded for quality and booking accuracy. In the 12 two-party/all-party consent states — including California — the AI announces that the call is being recorded before proceeding. See our Privacy Policy for the full notice.

These Terms of Service ("Terms") form a binding agreement between LacaStay LLC ("LacaStay," "we," "us") and the business entity that registers for the Service ("Customer," "you"). By creating an account, clicking "I agree," or using the Service, you accept these Terms.

You represent that you are authorized to bind your business, are at least 18 years old, and are registering on behalf of a business — the Service is not offered to individual consumers.
terms.s2b:
LacaStay provides an AI voice receptionist and booking-automation service for nail salons, spas, and vacation-rental businesses. The Service answers inbound calls, books appointments, sends reminders, and handles related communications on your behalf.

The Service does not guarantee any particular business outcome, call volume, or booking result, and uptime is not absolute. The Service is not for emergency use and must not be used to place emergency calls.
terms.s3b: You must provide accurate business information when registering. You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and for all activity under your account. Notify us promptly of any unauthorized use. One account per business location group, unless otherwise agreed.
terms.s4b:
Plans are billed monthly or annually in USD, in advance. Subscriptions auto-renew for the same term until cancelled.

  • We will notify you at least 30 days before each renewal.
  • Price changes take effect with at least 30 days' notice and apply from your next renewal.
  • If payment fails, we will retry and notify you; the Service may be suspended after a 7-day grace period.
  • Fees are non-refundable except as required by law. Cancelling stops future charges; your plan remains active until the end of the paid term.
terms.s5b: Trial access is limited to the features and period stated in the offer and converts to a paid plan at expiry unless you cancel. After a trial lapses without conversion, your trial data is retained for 30 days for export, then deleted.
terms.s6b:
You must not use the Service to:

  • Place calls or send texts to recipients without the consent required by the TCPA, the Telemarketing Sales Rule, or applicable state laws — you are solely responsible for obtaining and documenting consent.
  • Send spam, engage in harassment, or conduct unlawful, deceptive, or harmful activity.
  • Scrape, reverse-engineer, or attempt to extract the Service's models, prompts, or source code.
  • Resell the Service or use it for competitive benchmarking without our written consent.
  • Impersonate any person or business, or misrepresent the AI as a human employee.

We may suspend accounts engaged in TCPA abuse or other violations immediately and without prior notice.
terms.s7b:
You own your business data — contacts, call logs, recordings, transcripts, and bookings ("Customer Data"). You grant LacaStay a worldwide, non-exclusive license to host, process, and transmit Customer Data solely to provide and improve the Service for you.

You may export Customer Data in CSV format at any time during your subscription and for 30 days after termination.
terms.s8b:
The Service uses artificial intelligence to conduct phone conversations. You acknowledge that:

  • Calls are handled by an AI agent that identifies itself as AI on every call.
  • Transcriptions and summaries are generated automatically and may contain errors; we do not guarantee their accuracy.
  • You own the outputs generated for your account (transcripts, summaries, booking records).
  • You must not use the AI to deceive callers or for any unlawful purpose.
  • Your Customer Data is not used to train models serving other customers.
terms.s9b: LacaStay retains all right, title, and interest in the Service, including software, models, prompts, and trademarks. You receive a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Service during your subscription. You may not copy, modify, or create derivative works of the Service.
terms.s10b: Our collection and use of personal information is governed by our Privacy Policy. Business customers that are subject to data-protection laws may enter into our Data Processing Addendum, which is incorporated by reference where executed.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.disclaimer: These documents are provided for informational purposes and do not constitute legal advice.

privacy.s1b:
LacaStay LLC ("LacaStay," "we," "us") provides an AI voice receptionist and booking-automation service for businesses. We act as a service provider/processor for our business customers' end-customer data, and as a controller for our own account and website data.

Privacy contact: hello@lacastay.com.
privacy.s2b:
We collect the following categories of data:

  • Account & identity data: business name, contact name, email, phone number, billing address.
  • Payment data: processed by our payment provider; we store only tokens, never full card numbers.
  • Call recordings and transcripts: audio recordings of AI-handled calls and their machine-generated transcripts.
  • SMS content: messages sent and received through the Service.
  • End-customer phone numbers: numbers your customers provide when booking, collected on your behalf.
  • Usage & telemetry data: feature usage, call metadata (duration, time), device and log data.
  • Cookies & device data: see Section 11.

We explicitly collect audio: every AI-handled call may be recorded, as disclosed on the call itself.
privacy.s3b:
We use data only for these purposes:

  • Delivering the Service — placing and answering calls, booking appointments, sending reminders.
  • Billing and account administration.
  • Product improvement and troubleshooting — aggregated or de-identified where possible.
  • Customer support.
  • Marketing — only with your opt-in consent.

We do not use one customer's data to train AI models serving other customers.
privacy.s4b: Mobile information will not be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.
privacy.s5b: We engage vetted sub-processors to provide the Service — cloud hosting, telephony, AI voice, payments, email, and analytics. The current list is published on our Sub-processors page, with each vendor's name, purpose, and location. Every sub-processor is bound by a data-processing agreement limiting use of personal information to providing its service.
privacy.s6b: We do not "sell" personal information as defined by the CCPA/CPRA, and we do not "share" personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. We honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) opt-out signals on our website.
privacy.s7b:
Depending on your state, you may have the right to:

  • Know what personal information we collect and how we use it (right to know / access).
  • Request deletion of your personal information.
  • Request correction of inaccurate information.
  • Opt out of sale/sharing of personal information.
  • Limit the use of sensitive personal information (California).
  • Receive your data in a portable format.
  • Not be discriminated against for exercising these rights.

Submit requests via hello@lacastay.com or the contact form. We verify your identity before fulfilling requests and respond within 45 days as required by California law. If your request concerns data we hold on behalf of a business customer, we will direct you to that business where appropriate.
privacy.s8b: AI-handled calls may be recorded for booking accuracy and quality assurance. The AI agent announces that the call is being recorded at the start of the call where required by law. Twelve states — including California (Cal. Penal Code § 632), Florida, Maryland, Virginia, and Connecticut — require two-party/all-party consent to record calls; in those states the announcement is always made before recording begins.
privacy.s9b:
• Call recordings: 90 days, then deleted.
  • Call transcripts and SMS logs: 1 year.
  • Account data: for the life of the account, plus 2 years after closure.
  • Payment tokens: per our payment processor's requirements.
  • Backups: up to 90 days on a rolling basis.

After account deletion, personal information is deleted or de-identified according to this schedule unless a longer retention is required by law.
privacy.s10b: We protect personal information with industry-standard safeguards: encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication for staff systems, and comprehensive audit logging. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s11b: Our website uses strictly-necessary cookies (login, language preference) and, with consent, analytics cookies to understand site usage. You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser; the site remains usable. We honor Global Privacy Control signals as an opt-out of sale/sharing.
privacy.s12b: The Service is a business-to-business tool and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Where state laws extend protections to minors under 16 or 18 (for example, limits on sale of data or targeted advertising), we apply those protections.
privacy.s13b: Customer data is processed in the United States. If data from the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom is transferred to the US, we use appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses, and we will assess participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework as our international footprint evolves.
privacy.s14b: We will notify you of material changes to this policy by email and by posting the updated policy with a new effective date at least 30 days before it takes effect.
privacy.s15b:
California (CCPA/CPRA): California residents have the rights described in Section 7. We do not sell personal information. Under California's "Shine the Light" law, you may request information about disclosures of personal information for direct-marketing purposes — we make no such disclosures.

Other states: As of 2026, 19 states have comprehensive privacy laws in effect (including Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, and Texas). Residents of those states have substantially similar rights as described in Section 7; submit requests as described there.
privacy.contact: Privacy questions or rights requests: hello@lacastay.com.

hero.title: Data Processing Addendum
hero.sub: Last updated: October 11, 2026. This DPA forms part of the Terms of Service where executed by the parties.

dpa.s1b: This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") is between LacaStay LLC ("Processor") and the business customer ("Controller") that has executed it. It applies to personal data Processor handles on Controller's behalf through the Service ("Customer Personal Data"), including end-customer names, phone numbers, call recordings, transcripts, and SMS content.
dpa.s2b: Processing covers hosting, transmitting, and analyzing Customer Personal Data to provide the AI receptionist and booking service, for the duration of the subscription plus the 30-day post-termination export window described in the Terms.
dpa.s3b:
• Process Customer Personal Data only on Controller's documented instructions and only as necessary to provide the Service.
  • Ensure personnel with access are bound by confidentiality obligations.
  • Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures (see Section 5).
  • Not use Customer Personal Data to train models serving other customers.
  • Delete or return Customer Personal Data at the end of the engagement per the retention schedule.
dpa.s4b: Controller authorizes the sub-processors listed on our Sub-processors page. We will give at least 30 days' notice before adding or replacing a sub-processor; Controller may object on reasonable data-protection grounds, and if the objection cannot be resolved, Controller may terminate the affected services.
dpa.s5b: We maintain encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication, audit logging, and hosting on SOC 2-audited infrastructure.
dpa.s6b: Upon becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting Customer Personal Data, we will notify Controller without undue delay and in any event within 72 hours, providing the nature of the breach, categories of data affected, and mitigation steps taken.
dpa.s7b: We will assist Controller in fulfilling data-subject requests (access, deletion, correction, portability) by providing appropriate technical and organizational support, and will forward to Controller any such requests we receive directly.
dpa.s8b: Once per year, Controller (or an independent auditor it designates) may audit our compliance with this DPA on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, without unreasonably disrupting operations. We will make available relevant SOC 2 reports and certifications in lieu of on-site inspection where applicable.
dpa.s9b: Customer Personal Data is processed in the United States. Transfers outside the US/EEA/UK will be made only under an approved transfer mechanism such as Standard Contractual Clauses.
dpa.s10b: This DPA remains in effect for as long as we process Customer Personal Data on Controller's behalf. Its obligations survive termination to the extent data remains in our systems during the deletion window.
